sources.title: Horava-Lifshitz Gravity From Dynamical Newton-Cartan Geometry

new_independent_input.reason_for_admission_after_z24: Dynamical Newton-Cartan/Bargmann geometry is an independently developed action/geometric principle that explicitly identifies the origin of the Horava-Melby-Thompson U(1), unlike the generic covariant-aether bridge tested in Z26. It is admitted only to test whether that stronger geometric origin also fixes the unresolved physical-matter interface without RTK-response fitting.

frozen_question: Does the independently motivated dynamical Newton-Cartan/Bargmann construction, which explicitly geometrizes projectable Horava gravity and the HMT U(1), also uniquely derive the HMT physical-matter interface or an a1,a2-equivalent relation without using RTK response or soft-s cancellation?
decision_rule: Return SELECTOR_FOUND only if the source independently establishes every geometric claim and explicitly derives all selector requirements. If it establishes the projectable Newton-Cartan/HMT-U1 geometry but one or more selector requirements are absent, return NO_UNIQUE_MATTER_INTERFACE. If the source metadata cannot establish the frozen geometric claims, fail closed as SOURCE_AUDIT_INCOMPLETE.
forbidden: treating existence or geometric origin of HMT U1 as a unique matter-interface selector
selecting a1 or a2 from RTK pole/residue/remainder
using failed soft-s cancellation to choose Newton-Cartan matter couplings
